metadata.title: Paclitaxel 80 mg/m² weekly and Trastuzumab 21-day
metadata.indication: Adjuvant treatment of HER2-positive node-negative breast cancer ≤3 cm.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled · independent clinical/pharmacy review pending

metadata.schedule_summary: Paclitaxel weekly for 12 doses with trastuzumab every 3 weeks; continue trastuzumab to complete one year of HER2 treatment when appropriate. The team selects IV trastuzumab or locally approved subcutaneous trastuzumab; these are alternative formulations, not additional medicines.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding of the current NCCP source. It does not replace the official regimen, clinical judgement, local policy, prescribing review, or pharmacy verification.

action.recommendation: IV dose up to one week overdue: usual maintenance dose of 6 mg/kg as soon as possible after review; next maintenance dose 21 days later per EMA. Confirm actual history and cardiac assessment; not an automatic restart order.

action.recommendation: IV dose more than one week overdue: clinician-directed reload of 8 mg/kg over about 90 minutes, then 6 mg/kg 21 days later per EMA. NCCP 00815 page 4 contains conflicting weekly wording; reconcile with oncology/pharmacy and do not administer 6 mg/kg weekly.

action.recommendation: Do not administer the next SC trastuzumab dose at an interval shorter than 21 days. Verify the actual administration history and reschedule under the prescribing team.

Complete the prescribed one-year HER2 course; verify route and loading requirements.
